name: EmbedWay Technologies (Shanghai) Corporation
summary: EmbedWay Technologies (Shanghai) Corporation engages in the provision of network visibility, intelligent system platforms, and intelligent computing solutions and services in China and internationally. It offers products and solutions for telecom networks, industrial internet, and intelligent computing centers. The company also provides ExProbe, a 40G/100G ethernet acquisition and distribution device; OptiPlus, a multi-service traffic collection and distribution platform; ExProbe8580E for inline tools flow; ExProbe8512E, an ethernet network packet broker; and PA8921 FPGA acceleration card, a data center application acceleration platform.
